issues.issue: Can a claimant who has completed his sentence for a serious non-political crime still be excluded under Article 1F(b)?
issues.applicant_position: Says he completed his six-year sentence, so the Article 1F(b) exclusion should not apply.
issues.result_quote: It can now be said that the member’s view was an error in law.

issues.issue: Should the member's finding that the applicant is excluded under Article 1F(b) be set aside?
issues.applicant_position: Exclusion finding should be set aside; the Minister gave no notice that Article 1F(b) would be in issue at the first hearing.
issues.result_quote: I have concluded that the member’s decision will be set aside.

issues.issue: Did the member breach procedural fairness in handling the adjournment and new counsel?
issues.result_quote: Parenthetically, if it were necessary to decide the issue, I would have concluded that the member breached procedural fairness.
